name: Spinach & Cheddar Omelette with Crispy Potatoes
method: Boil the baby potatoes for 10 minutes, drain, halve and fry in half the oil for 8 minutes until crisp.
Beat the eggs with a pinch of pepper. Heat the remaining oil in a non-stick pan and pour in the eggs; as they begin to set, scatter over the spinach and grated cheddar.
Fold the omelette over, cook for another minute and serve with the potatoes.
